behaviors_covered.sensors.ntc_steinhart_hart: Complete cubic non-default oracle; finite-difference sensitivity; monotone resistance response; C=0; signed A; reciprocal calibration endpoint equality; scalar, interval and extrapolation rejection/recovery.
behaviors_covered.sensors.platinum_callendar_van_dusen: Complete independent -200/-50/0/150/850 C oracles; subzero quartic and positive quadratic; zero-branch continuity; tiny nonzero curvature; R0 scaling; scalar/range rejection/recovery.
behaviors_covered.sensors.type_t_cold_junction_emf: Complete independently fetched NIST non-default oracle; junction exchange and sensitivity relocation; equal junctions; 0/400 C boundaries; adjacent-f64 signed signal; both junction range errors/recovery.
behaviors_covered.sensors.hall_plate_angle: Complete negative-bias thirty-degree oracle; current/material/orientation reversal; zero field/current/coefficient; zero/quarter-turn angle; inclusive signed-current and field limits; scalar/coupled rejection/recovery.
behaviors_covered.sensors.amr_angular_resistance: Complete negative-anisotropy forty-five-degree oracle; pi periodicity; current sign; parallel/perpendicular limits; positive/zero anisotropy and zero bias; all-orientation positivity; current/scalar rejection/recovery.
behaviors_covered.sensors.hydrogen_activity_electrode: Complete three-decade negative-voltage oracle; equal activity offset; exchange symmetry; both activity and temperature endpoints; adjacent-f64 signed activity signal; scalar errors/recovery.
behaviors_covered.sensors.differential_gap_capacitor: Complete non-default negative-displacement oracle; signed symmetry; centered zero; dielectric scaling; both dimension branches at thin-gap equality; near contact; normal and subnormal tiny displacement; geometry/scalar rejection/recovery.

shared_coverage: Every input of every ID receives NaN/+infinity/-infinity and same-thread valid recovery. Shared common helper only. Complete-output non-default oracles for all seven IDs.

oracle_provenance.other_models: Research source equations and feature contracts read; independent 70-digit decimal arithmetic, elementary angle identities, finite-difference and scaling invariants. No catalog expected maps read into tests.
oracle_provenance.tolerances: Relative-only comparisons except documented trigonometric zero residuals and one minimum-subnormal quantization step. No engine execution.

verification: Not executed: no build, test, lint, formatter, calculator process or native launch. Parent must run backend sensors integration target and the flat JSON-lines scenarios after integration.
untested_gaps: Compiled Rust and process assertions remain unexecuted.
Native interaction/image acceptance belongs to Main and V2SensorsRun.
No hardware calibration, self-heating, electrode interference, fringing validation or complete binary64-space enumeration.

suspected_defects.status: source-derived, not executed; regression intentionally asserts corrected behavior
suspected_defects.expected: differential_capacitance approximately +/-1.77083756256e-320 F, nonzero; one minimum-subnormal tolerance 5e-324 F. Other outputs remain finite.
suspected_defects.source_prediction: Current multiplication forms about +/-1.77083756e-324 before final division by 1e-4; the intermediate rounds to signed zero despite representable final output.
suspected_defects.minimal_correction: Evaluate (2*near_capacitance)*(displacement/(rest_gap+displacement)) so final underflow occurs only at the true output scale.
suspected_defects.origin: V2SensorsRun analytical finding; independently retained as a signed failing regression.
